title: Volume Pricing for New Interior Casing — Installation Jobs
content:
**Volume pricing for new interior casing — Installation Jobs**

How the casing price on an **Installation Jobs** record is built depends on the casing openings of the job. The casing openings belong to the contract the job installs — the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract of a window job, or the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract of a door job — and casing is priced on every opening on that contract.

## Price ladder

| Casing openings | Casing price |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | the first 10 at the method's interior trim charge per opening, and every casing opening beyond 10 at 80 percent of it |
| 6 or more but fewer than 12 | every casing opening at 90 percent of the method's interior trim charge per opening |
| fewer than 6 | every casing opening at the method's interior trim charge per opening |

## Worked examples (hypothetical charge of 69.00 per opening)

| Casing openings | Working | Casing price |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | 10 at 69.00 is 690.00; 5 at 80 percent of 69.00 is 276.00; together | 966.00 |
| 12 | 690.00 plus 2 at 55.20, that is 110.40; together | 800.40 |
| 9 | 9 at 90 percent of 69.00, that is 9 at 62.10 | 558.90 |
| 6 | 6 at 62.10 | 372.60 |
| 5 | 5 at 69.00 | 345.00 |

The band is fixed by the casing openings of the job as a whole; within the first band, the openings beyond 10 are the ones priced at 80 percent.
